title: Split duplicate atoms defeat strict D-Voronoi closure
statement: If coincident positive-weight score atoms may occupy different singleton cells, a positive-definite labeling can be vacuously one-point exchange stable while strict nearest-centroid assignment and deterministic score-only label reproduction fail.

proof_location.section: CE-D-UNMERGED-DUPLICATES-001 — split duplicate atoms block strict D-Voronoi closure

role: boundary condition for the finite D theorem and compiler
